title: Hecla Reports Excellent Q2 2026 Exploration Results at Keno Hill, New Veins Discovered at Midas, and Positive Definition Results at Greens Creek
summary: Continued High-Grade Discoveries at Midas and Keno Hill Extend Key Mineralized Trends and Support District-Scale Growth Targets Hecla Mining Company (NYSE: HL) today reported positive second quarter 2026 exploration and definition drilling results from its Keno Hill, Midas, and Greens Creek properties, highlighted by a significant extension of high-grade mineralization at Keno Hill toward the historic Hector-Calumet Mine and discovery of new high-grade veins at Midas. The Company also advanced exploration programs across its portfolio, by initiating drilling at Hollister and finalizing drill pad construction at Aurora in preparation for drilling in August. Figure 1: Keno Hill Bermingham – Hector Calumet longitudinal section showing the recent high-grade drillhole intercepts open to the northeast and southwest for expansion "Our exploration teams delivered another quarter of tangible progress toward our district-scale growth targets," said Kurt Allen, Vice President of Exploration.
